--- original

@@ -1,6 +1,20 @@
 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m50a3xd4fe2wp3dat39rr3m0
+  text: |-
+    Review result (no code change).
+
+    1. Protects against: a model that starts a new background run in each answer, so each settlement starts one more answer with no end (generation-queue.md:198; ^3qx0mpt saw more than 250 submissions). Added in 88f6bfd3. Default 100 (SessionConfiguration.swift:55); 0 holds all run mail. An answer counts 1 when it delivered only run mail (a background run terminal or a ToolContext.message event; progress and .elicitation run events start no answer). One answer counts one time, also with many submissions. User-type mail (user message, .agentMessage, .elicitationAnswer) sets the count to zero (RoutedSessionActorPump.swift:296-307). Check at RoutedSessionActorPump.swift:166.
+
+    2. Who can reach it: no consumer sets another value (ACPAgent SessionSetup.swift:1030, Agents AgentEnvironment.swift:182 uses the default; Multitool ignores the event). Batching joins all queued run mail into one answer. Elicitation answers and parent messages reset the count, so the elicitation flows cannot reach it. Realistic case: a long agent tree with many `send caller` messages and few user inputs, for example 10 children x 10 messages that settle one at a time while the model is idle (up to N*(k+1) answers, fewer with batching). N children with only a final message reach it only with N >= 100 that settle one at a time.
+
+    3. When reached: the batch goes back as held mail, no answer starts, MailDeliveryPause(limit:heldMail:) goes out on streamSessionEvents(); held mail counts as idle, so workEnded/idle follow; only user-type mail resumes delivery. ACPAgent: ACPEventTranslator.swift:382-386 sends nothing; the client sees idle with no notice; headless `acp-agent run` exits at the first idle and the held results are lost. Agents: AgentRun+Drive.swift:195-197,307 calls cancelAll() and ends .failed(.mailDeliveryPaused), which cancels all child runs; agents-demo shows "paused". No deadlock found: an elicitation answer goes to the run plane first and is user-type mail; a parent fails, it does not hang (NestedRunTests+Messages.swift:379).
+
+    4. Recommendation: keep the limit and its rule; do not remove it (the only guard against the self-caused loop); do not change the default without a measured case. Follow-ups: (a) optional: count only answers in which the model started a new background run, because only such answers can loop; (b) ACPAgent: show the pause to the client, and headless run must not exit as done while mail is held; (c) Agents: do not cancelAll() the tree at once on a pause, or document that a big agent tree needs a higher limit.
+  timestamp: 2026-10-15T17:35:18.436254+00:00
